info.name: FlavorDB API - Complete Collection
info.description: Postman collection for the FlavorDB API covering all 64 endpoints, with request descriptions and default query values. Ready to import and use.

variable.description: FoodoScope gateway (IIIT-Delhi). Request paths already include /flavordb.
Your FoodoScope API key. Set it in your environment's Current value (not the Initial value), so it isn't shared if you export or share the collection.

item.name: Entities By Molecule Id
item.description: Reverse lookup: finds every ingredient/entity containing the specified flavor molecule (pubchemId = pubchem_id). df(m) = response.length. Use Importance(m) = 1/df(m) for rarity weighting. Example: pubchemId=6549 (Linalool) returns 130 ingredients.

item.name: Entity Controller
item.description: APIs for food items and ingredients (entities) in the database

item.name: Entities By Natural Source
item.description: Finds all foods or ingredients that come from a specific natural source. Use when researching what foods share the same natural origin or source.

request.description: Finds all foods or ingredients that come from a specific natural source. Use when researching what foods share the same natural origin or source.

item.name: Entities By Name And Category
item.description: Searches for foods or ingredients by their name and category type. Use when you need to find specific foods within a particular category (like fruits, vegetables, meats, etc.).

request.description: Searches for foods or ingredients by their name and category type. Use when you need to find specific foods within a particular category (like fruits, vegetables, meats, etc.).

item.name: Entities By Readable Name
item.description: Searches for foods using their common, everyday names. Use when you want to look up a food using the name people actually use (like 'apple' instead of scientific names).

request.description: Searches for foods using their common, everyday names. Use when you want to look up a food using the name people actually use (like 'apple' instead of scientific names).

item.name: Molecules By Entity Id (Sorted by Rarity)
item.description: Returns the full chemical profiles of every flavor molecule contained within the specified ingredient/entity, sorted from rarest to most common. Use for ingredient-to-molecule mapping. entity_id can be found via /entities/by-entity-alias-readable.

request.description: Returns the full chemical profiles of every flavor molecule contained within the specified ingredient/entity, sorted from rarest to most common. Use for ingredient-to-molecule mapping. entity_id can be found via /entities/by-entity-alias-readable.

item.name: Compact Molecules By Entity Id (Sorted by Rarity)
item.description: Lightweight endpoint returning only pubchem_id and common_name for each molecule in an ingredient, sorted from rarest to most common. Ideal for building df(m) frequency tables for rarity-weighted flavor pairing: Pair(A,B) = sum(1/df(m)) for shared molecules.

request.description: Lightweight endpoint returning only pubchem_id and common_name for each molecule in an ingredient, sorted from rarest to most common. Ideal for building df(m) frequency tables for rarity-weighted flavor pairing: Pair(A,B) = sum(1/df(m)) for shared molecules.

request.description: Finds a food item by its name and returns similar foods that pair well with it. Use when you want to discover what foods go well together or find pairing suggestions for a specific food item.
